integrity.proof_method: exhaustive binary split-depth classification plus positive-part conversion

scientific_limitations: The exact scalar inverse theorem is for known common base cardinality, two through five represented equivalence classes, and all classes infinite in the ambient homogeneous model. It cannot reconstruct the graph induced on the base; the type-count formula itself is established earlier, not a novel result. The all-size binary splitting classification is deductive, with finite checker corroboration. Priority is provisional.
title: Five-class binary-carry collisions in homogeneous multipartite singleton-type counts
